label: MCP9808 Freezer Monitor Demo
info: An Inject node fires every 5 seconds, triggering the periph-mcp9808 node to read the temperature and Alert status, which a Function node formats into a log line. The node is configured with TCRIT at -5 °C — the "too warm, door left open" threshold for a freezer — with the Alert source set to TCRIT only and the Alert in latched interrupt mode. When the freezer warms past TCRIT the node emits a separate {source: "critical"} message; the Function node turns it into an alarm notification on the Debug sidebar and sends {clear_interrupt: true} back into the node to re-arm the latched Alert. To try it without a freezer, raise TCRIT just above room temperature and warm the sensor with a fingertip.

name: format reading / raise alarm
